We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join our autonomous agents team at AnthroTech Solutions.

Role Responsibilities:
- Design, build, and deploy agentic AI pipelines and multi-agent coordination systems using LangGraph, Python, and LLM APIs.
- Architect resilient state management and fault-tolerant execution graphs for background automation workflows.
- Integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and external APIs for seamless tool calling.
- Maintain production observability, error tracking, and latency metrics using Prometheus and Grafana.

Requirements:
- 3+ years experience with Python, FastAPI, and asynchronous programming.
- Deep hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or agentic frameworks.
- Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and cloud deployments.
- Strong communication skills and a passion for building reliable AI software.
